name: btreewide
algorithm: std ordered map of u64 to a 256-byte [32]u64 value: n splitmix64 keys inserted, n lookups (half present), one ascending iteration, every key removed (README.md). The node width with a large value (COLL2-5).

skip.zig: no std ordered map (std.Treap is an intrusive treap of caller-owned nodes, not a map)

notes: Written by std-coll2 (status/std-coll2.md). The checksum folds with wrapping arithmetic in every column.
